subject: Problem to refer to an external function from dplyr in my package

messages.author: 6d516dae6aab4320
messages.subject: Problem to refer to an external function from dplyr in my package
parts:
Hey all,

I'm developing a package in which among others I use functions from dplyr. When I use devtools::load_all() and then run my function (that also includes the following lines of code) I get this error:
Error: could not find function "%>%" 



          temp <- raw_data_dvc %>%
                  dplyr::group_by(id, within_condition) %>%
                  dplyr::summarise(n = mean(dvc[abs(z_score) < sd_criterion[j]])) %>%
                  reshape2::dcast(id ~ within_condition, value.var = "n")



I tried to put dplyr:: before the first %>% but I also get an error.

What am I doing wrong?

Any help will be greatly appreciated!

Best,

Ayala

messages.author: 73b9a5b50f4537e5
messages.subject: Re: Problem to refer to an external function from dplyr in my package
parts:
If you're using roxygen2, you can use this line to import `%>%` into your package:
#' @importFrom dplyr "%>%"

If you're not using roxygen, add this line to the NAMESPACE:
importFrom(dplyr,"%>%")

The `%>%` function is re-exported from dplyr, which imports it from magrittr. I don't know if it's possible / how to refer to such a function with the "dplyr::" syntax.

Liz
